suggestions.point: The 'animal_pose_auditor' is selected to verify anatomical structure, but the plan lacks a prerequisite step to locate the subject. The 'open_vocabulary_detector' should be added as a precursor to provide bounding box priors for the topology and pose auditors, ensuring they focus on the correct instance amidst the complex grass background.

The 'fine_grained_classifier' is tasked with distinguishing weasels from ferrets/martens. While valid, the visual distinction in this specific close-up (head/shoulders only) is subtle. The plan should explicitly instruct the classifier to look for specific cranial ratios (snout length vs skull width) which are key differentiators visible in this crop, rather than just general class confidence.

The animal has reddish-brown fur on its back and head, with white/cream fur on its chest and underbelly. Its head is turned towards the camera, showing dark eyes and small rounded ears. The body is partially obscured by the foreground grass, but appears slender.
